mapper.select:
SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN account_group g ON g.id = a.account_group_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ip_proxy p ON p.bound_account_id = a.id AND p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 2 WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' AND UPPER(TRIM(a.protocol_id)) IN ('WEB', 'ANDROID') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM feed_task_account existing WHERE existing.task_id = #{taskId} AND existing.account_id = a.id )
AND (a.ws_phone LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR a.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.ws_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%') AND a.account_type = #{accountType} AND a.protocol_id = #{protocolId} AND a.number_source = #{numberSource} AND a.channel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{channelName}, '%') AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND s.account_state = #{accountState} AND s.login_state = #{loginState} AND s.risk_status = #{riskStatus} AND s.mute_status = #{muteStatus} AND COALESCE(s.proxy_country, p.region) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{country}, '%') AND s.truth_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{truthIp}, '%')
AND s.account_state = 2 AND s.login_state = 1 AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM marketing_account_occupancy occupancy WHERE occupancy.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND occupancy.account_id = a.id )
AND ( s.account_state IS NULL OR s.account_state != 2 OR s.login_state IS NULL OR s.login_state != 1 OR g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM marketing_account_occupancy occupancy WHERE occupancy.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND occupancy.account_id = a.id ) )
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
